items.title: Call to Order
Roll Call
Approval of the Minutes: January 23, 2020 Special Budget Hearing #3
Approval of the Minutes: January 28, 2020 Regular Meeting
Approval of the Minutes: January 30, 2020 Special Budget Hearing #4
General Public Comment

Communications: Calendar; Correspondence; Contract Advertisement Report; 2009 Water Supply Agreement; Annual Report on Dry Year Supply Progress; January Budget Hearings; SFPUC 2020 Utility Tech Report; Sewer Inspection/Replacement; Water Supply Conditions; Water System Improvement Status
General Manager Report: Bay Delta Water Quality, CleanPowerSF, PG&E’s Bankruptcy and City’s Acquisition, Water System Improvement Program
New Commission Business
Approve the plans and specs in the amount of $1,480,025 to install fall protection and access improvements
Accept work performed by Trinet Construction, Inc. for a total contract amount of $4,187,382
Accept work performed by Monterey Mechanical Co. for a total contract amount of $2,882,303, and increasing the contract duration by 163 calendar days
Approve the plans and specifications, and award Bay Corridor Transmission & Distribution – Phase 2 (2019) North, in the amount of $24,058,409
Approve the selection of GEI Consultants, Inc. (GEI) in an amount not-to-exceed $11,000,000 and with a duration of 11 years
Adopt a finding declaring as “exempt surplus land” portions of the unimproved property owned by the City and County of San Francisco
Adopt the SFPUC Operating Budget for FY 2020-21 and 2021-22; Adopt the Programmatic Project Budget for FY 2020-21 and FY 2021-22, and Appropriate funds for capital projects
Discussion and possible action to adopt the Two-Year Capital Budget of the SFPUC consisting of $435,699,986 for FY 2020-21 and $835,878,748 for FY 2021-22
Discussion and possible action to adopt the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission 10-Year Capital Plan for FY 2020-21 through FY 2029-30 totaling $8,995,702,530
Discussion and possible action to adopt the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission 10-Year Financial Plan for FY 2020-21 through FY 2029-30
Authorize the GM to execute a MOU with the Real Estate Division of the City and County of SF to allow the SFPUC to install a photovoltaic solar energy system at a cost of $500,000
Public Comment on matters to be addressed during Closed Session
Motion on whether to assert the attorney-client privilege regarding the matters listed as Conference with Legal Counsel
Conference with Legal Counsel - Jennifer Roldan v. City and County of San Francisco
Conference with Legal Counsel – San Joaquin Tributaries Authority, et al v. California State Water Resources Control Board
Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation, Pacific Gas & Electric Corporation
Conference with Legal Counsel – City and County of San Francisco v. Pacific Gas & Electric Company
Conference with Legal Counsel – City and County of San Francisco v. Pacific Gas & Electric Federal Energy Regulatory Commission Complaint
Announcement following Closed Session
Motion regarding whether to disclose the discussions during Closed Session
Adjournment
